movelist.name: Defog
movelist.effect: The Weather becomes Clear, and all Blessings, Coats, and Hazards are destroyed. Clear Weather is the default weather, conferring no innate bonuses or penalties of any sort.

movelist.name: Brine
movelist.effect: If the target’s Hit Points are under 50%, Brine’s Damage Base is increased to Damage Base 13 (4d10+10 / 35).

movelist.name: Refresh
movelist.effect: The user is cured of all Poison, Burns, and Paralysis.

movelist.name: Soak
movelist.effect: The target gains the Water Type in addition to its other Types for 5 turns.

movelist.name: Whirlpool
movelist.effect: The target is put in a Vortex.

movelist.name: Water Pulse
movelist.effect: Water Pulse Confuses the target on 17+.

abilities.name: Misty Surge
abilities.effect: The Field becomes Misty, as if affected by the Move Misty Terrain, for one full round.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.effect: The user gains +1 Evasion. Whenever an Ally uses a damaging area-of-effect attack that would hit you, you may Disengage as a Free Action before the attack resolves.

abilities.name: Wash Away
abilities.trigger: The user hits with a Water Type Move
abilities.effect: Before the Move “hits”, all Combat Stages on targets hit by the Move are reset to their default (usually 0), and all coats on the targets, except ones placed by Water Sport, are destroyed.
